about: Real screenshots of the tools in templates/studios.json, used only where the project's own terms clearly allow it. One record per tool id. scripts/dev/toolbox-shots.py makes the web sizes from 'original'; scripts/dev/site-toolbox.js writes site/assets/toolbox/credits.json from this file. A tool with no record here keeps its drawn card (docs/SCREENSHOT-PERMISSIONS.md says why).
